# OPC Radar
> OPC Radar is a free opportunity radar for one-person companies (OPC), indie developers, designers and cross-border sellers. It collects AI tools, GitHub repos, new products, news, deals and ideas from public sources (Hacker News, GitHub, Hugging Face, DEV, Lobsters and a curated list), translates them into 10 languages and refreshes automatically. Currently 920 items.

- Site: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/
- Data (JSON): https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/data/items.json
- Languages: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de (append ?lang=<code>)
- Publisher: Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
- Full list: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/llms-full.txt
- Updated: 2026-11-21T09:12:14Z

## Deals
- [GitHub Student Developer Package](https://education.github.com/pack) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The students are certified free of charge and receive dozens of development tools and clouds (domain names, cloud hosts, IDE, etc.).
- [Cloudflare Workers free of charge](https://workers.cloudflare.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): 100,000 requests per day for deployment of edge functions, stationary stations and KV, starting with independent developers.
- [Oracle Claude Allways Free](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/free/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Permanent free ARM cloud hosts and storage lines suitable for running small services and reptiles.
- [Google Cloud Free Trial and Free Level](https://cloud.google.com/free) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The new users offered a trial grant and a long-term free layer of products.
- [AWS Free Tier](https://aws.amazon.com/free/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The new account is free of charge and on a trial basis, covering calculations, storage, databases.
- [AWS Activate Entrepreneurship Support](https://aws.amazon.com/activate/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Creative companies can apply for AWS cloud scale and technical support.
- [Google for Startups Cloud Programme](https://cloud.google.com/startup) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The original company applied for the Google Cloud level, which is higher for AI.
- [Microsoft for Startups](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/startups) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Initial corporate support schemes, including the Azure scale and development tools.
- [Free-for.dev list of free services](https://free-for.dev/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Developmentists provide free-of-charge community-based services, organized by category.
- [Jetbrains Education Free Authorization](https://www.jetbrains.com/community/education/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Students and teachers have free access to the Jetbrains IDE.
- [Notion for Startups](https://www.notion.com/startups) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Eligible start-up teams can apply for a notion payment scheme discount.
- [Supabase Free Scheme](https://supabase.com/pricing) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Postgres + Authentication + Storage Free Layer, MVP backend sufficient.
- [Vercel Hobby Free Scheme](https://vercel.com/pricing) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The individual project hosts the frontend and Serverless functions free of charge, with a global CDN.
- [Netlifty, free set.](https://www.netlify.com/pricing/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Static stations and functions are hosted free of charge and forms and deployment previews are open.
- [Fly.io free of charge](https://fly.io/docs/about/pricing/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Small packaging applications can be deployed at low cost to multiple regions worldwide.
- [Render Free Examples](https://render.com/pricing) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Web services, Postgress and static stations provide a free layer for Demo.
- [Neon Servers Postgres Free Level](https://neon.tech/pricing) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The branch database is supported on a free-of-charge basis by Postgress.
- [Hugging Faces](https://huggingface.co/spaces) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Free hosting of AI Demo (Gradio/Streamlit), good community exposure.
- [Google AI Studio Free API](https://aistudio.google.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The Gemini model provides a free call line and is easy to make.
- [Groq Free API](https://console.groq.com/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Super-fast reasoning open source model API, free call level.
- [OpenRouter Free Model](https://openrouter.ai/models) (Curated, 2026-10-12): An API polymer multi-model, some of which can be called free of charge.
- [Cloudflare R2 Free of charge](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/) (Curated, 2026-10-12): The object is stored free of charge and without terminal traffic charges for 10 GB per month.
- [GitHub Copilot Student/Open Source Free](https://github.com/features/copilot) (Curated, 2026-10-12): Copilot is free of charge to students and hot open source defenders.
